ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (27) Omitted.

(28) Part of the Rules on Emeritus Professors shall be amended as follows:

In Article 6 (2), "Minister of Education, Science and Technology" shall be replaced with "Minister of Education".

(29) through (61) Omitted.
